description: Real-time communication platform. Industry brain defines the context and purpose of communication. This core defines how messaging, channels, and real-time interaction work.

relationships: Conversation is between two or more Users
Message belongs to Conversation, sent by User
Channel is a group Conversation with a topic
Attachment belongs to Message — file, image, video
Reaction belongs to Message, sent by User
Notification belongs to User, triggered by new Message or mention
Contact is a User saved by another User
Group is a named Conversation with many Users
Call is initiated between Users, can be voice or video
Status belongs to User — online, away, busy, offline
Bot is a special User type that sends automated Messages

mvp.description: Core messaging — 1-1 chat, group chat, media sharing, notifications.
primary_flows: Sign up → set up profile → find contact → start conversation → send message → receive reply
Create group → add members → send message to group → members reply
Receive notification → open message → reply → continue conversation

interaction_patterns: Message bubbles — sent messages right aligned, received left aligned
Typing indicator — animated dots in conversation
Read receipts — single tick sent, double tick delivered, filled double tick read
Long press message — context menu with react, reply, copy, delete
Swipe right on message to reply — quoted message appears in input
Emoji reaction picker — long press or double tap to react
Unread badge on conversation — bold conversation name
Online status dot on avatar — green online, grey offline

scale.description: Enterprise messaging platform with workspaces, bots, integrations, compliance, and admin.
primary_flows: Enterprise admin creates workspace → adds teams → sets permissions → members onboard via SSO
Set up bot → configure commands → bot responds to triggers in channels
Connect integration → app posts updates to channel automatically → team notified
Compliance admin exports message history → satisfies audit requirement
Group video call with 50+ participants — breakout rooms, screen share, recording
